results = {}

    elif path.endswith('.parquet'): df = pd.read_parquet(path)

    # Preprocess
    df = df[df['Исход'].isin(['Выписан', 'Мертв'])]  # Filter relevant outcomes

    # === Analysis 1: Descriptive Statistics by Outcome Group ===
    try:
        variables = ["возраст", "SpO2 %", "WBC V1 10*9", "Длительность госпитализации"]
        table = [["Variable", "Group", "Mean", "Std Dev", "Median", "IQR", "Min", "Max"]]
        for var in variables:
            for group in ['Выписан', 'Мертв']:
                subset = df[df['Исход'] == group][var].dropna()
                mean = subset.mean()
                std = subset.std()
                median = subset.median()
                iqr = subset.quantile(0.75) - subset.quantile(0.25)
                min_val = subset.min()
                max_val = subset.max()
                table.append([var, group, round(mean, 4), round(std, 4), round(median, 4), round(iqr, 4), round(min_val, 4), round(max_val, 4)])
        
        results["descriptive_statistics"] = {
            "title": "Descriptive Statistics by Outcome Group",
            "table": table,
            "plots": [],
            "stats": {}
        }
    except Exception as e:
        errors.append(f"Descriptive Statistics failed: {str(e)}")

    try:
        variables = ["возраст", "SpO2 %", "WBC V1 10*9", "температура"]
        table = [["Variable", "U Statistic", "p-value"]]
        for var in variables:
            group1 = df[df['Исход'] == 'Выписан'][var].dropna()

            "plots": [],

        table = [["Variable", "Coefficient", "Odds Ratio", "CI Lower", "CI Upper", "p-value"]]
